description.value: You learn two 1st-level tech powers, which count as universal force powers for you without counting against the Powers Known total on the consular table. At 7th level you learn two more tech powers of 1st or 2nd level; at 13th level, two more of 1st through 3rd level; and at 17th level, two more of 1st through 4th level. Whenever you gain a level in this class, you may swap one tech power you know for a different tech power of the same level.
